summary: Implemented the show_speed feature. In rich/progress.py: TaskProgressColumn gained a show_speed option (default False), a static render_speed(speed) method using filesize.pick_unit_and_suffix, and a render override that returns speed text for unknown totals when show_speed is on. track() gained a show_speed parameter (default True) passed to the column. Progress.track no longer raises for unsized iterables with no total; task_total is declared Optional[float]. CHANGELOG.md has the new Unreleased/Added line. In tests/test_progress.py, the two ValueError assertions were removed and test_task_progress_column_speed was added. Nothing was committed. Tests, mypy, and black were not run, per the instructions, so they remain unverified.
